topics.title: Photosynthesis
topics.answer: Photosynthesis is the process by which green plants make food using light energy, water, and carbon dioxide. Oxygen is released as a by-product.

topics.title: Percentage
topics.answer: A percentage is a way of expressing a number as a fraction of 100. For example, 25% means 25 out of 100, or 25/100.

topics.title: Noun
topics.answer: A noun is a word used to name a person, place, thing, or idea. Examples include teacher, Chennai, book, and happiness.

topics.title: HTML
topics.answer: HTML stands for HyperText Markup Language. It provides the structure and meaning of content on web pages using elements such as headings, paragraphs, links, and forms.

topics.title: Earth
topics.answer: Earth is the third planet from the Sun. It has a liquid-water-rich surface and is currently the only planet known to support life.
